data.description: SQL编程练习 - 窗口函数

text:
-- 使用ROW_NUMBER排名
SELECT
    name,
    city,
    age,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS rank_num
FROM users;

-- 按分组排名
SELECT
    name,
    city,
    age,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY age DESC) AS city_rank
FROM users;

-- 计算累计总和
SELECT
    order_id,
    user_id,
    amount,
    SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at) AS running_total
FROM orders;

-- 使用LEAD和LAG函数
SELECT
    order_id,
    amount,
    created_at,
    LAG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY created_at) AS prev_amount,
    LEAD(amount) OVER (ORDER BY created_at) AS next_amount
FROM orders;

-- 使用NTILE分组
SELECT
    name,
    amount,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS quartile
FROM orders;
